About.headline: A video-first audiovisual editor in Fort Lauderdale.

bio.paragraph1: Esteban Moreno is a Fort Lauderdale-based audiovisual editor who leads with video: pacing, story, color, sound, captions, and the final cut people actually watch.
bio.paragraph2: He works in English and Spanish, on set and in the edit. That bilingual range matters across Broward and Miami, where shoots and audiences often move between languages.
bio.paragraph3: The focus is video first — reels, promos, recap edits, aerial visuals, and content for businesses. Photography is available when the project needs supporting stills.

Packages.headline: Three starting-at packages built for South Florida brands.
Packages.lede: Self-qualify before the call. These offers anchor what the most common video projects cost — edit-only cutdowns, single content days, and a monthly retainer for local businesses that need repeat content. Every package is a starting point: the final quote follows a short call once we understand the deadline, platform, and what the footage has to do.
Packages.indexHeading: Pick the simplest place to start.
Packages.indexBody: Each card shows the typical range, what is included, and the caveats we will not bury at the bottom of a quote. Numbers are starting points — final pricing follows a short scoping call.
Packages.ctaHeading: Ready to scope a video project?
Packages.ctaBody: Send the deadline, footage status, platform, and city. We will recommend the simplest package or a custom scope — usually within two business days.
Packages.stripHeading: Anchored offers for South Florida video.
Packages.stripBody: Edit-only starter, single content day, and monthly retainer — pick the closest fit or ask for a custom scope.

edit-only-starter.name: Edit-Only Starter
edit-only-starter.tagline: For clients who already have footage and need one clean short-form cut.
edit-only-starter.blurb: Send footage. Get back one polished Reel, Short, or TikTok with captions, music direction, pacing, and a color pass.
edit-only-starter.audience: Founders, creators, real estate teams, and local businesses with phone, camera, or drone footage that needs a sharper cut.

deliverables.0: One Reel, Short, TikTok, or promo cut from your supplied footage
deliverables.1: Captions, music direction, pacing, and a color pass
deliverables.2: One round of revisions on the edit
deliverables.3: Platform-native export (9:16 vertical by default; 1:1 or 16:9 on request)

caveats.0: Starting-at price assumes usable footage and a clear reference — heavy salvage edits scope up
caveats.1: 48–72 hour turnaround is a target, not a guarantee — confirmed only after a capacity check
caveats.2: Edit-only does not include shooting, drone capture, or stock licensing

0.question: What footage works for this package?
0.answer: Phone, mirrorless camera, GoPro, or drone footage all work. Send a folder link with the clips, a reference Reel or TikTok, and the platform you plan to publish on.

1.question: Do I get the project file?
1.answer: You get the final export plus one revision pass. The project file stays archived on Esteban's side so future re-cuts and platform resizes are easy to scope.

2.question: Can captions be in Spanish?
2.answer: Yes. Captions, on-screen text, and music direction can be EN, ES, or bilingual — pick what fits the audience.

3.question: Can this scale into more clips?
3.answer: Yes. The Edit-Only Starter is the entry point. Multi-clip batches and recurring edits scope into a Content Day Mini or the Local Business Monthly retainer.

content-day-mini.name: Content Day Mini
content-day-mini.tagline: A focused half-day shoot plus a hero edit and short vertical cutdowns.
content-day-mini.blurb: One short on-location session that becomes a hero promo plus three to five vertical clips — built for local businesses launching or refreshing their feed.
content-day-mini.audience: Restaurants, gyms, salons, med spas, founders, and event leads who need fresh footage and several clips out of a single content session.

deliverables.0: Two-hour local shoot at one location with clear shot plan
deliverables.1: One hero edit (vertical or horizontal, your call)
deliverables.2: Three to five vertical short-form cutdowns from the same session
deliverables.3: Thumbnail and still selects for stories, posts, and listing use
deliverables.4: Optional supporting photos when the shoot allows time for stills

caveats.0: Price assumes one location, one half-day window, and South Florida travel — extended locations scope up
caveats.1: Drone capture is included only when location, weather, airspace, and legal requirements allow
caveats.2: Talent direction, props, makeup, and food styling are not included unless explicitly scoped

0.question: Where can the shoot happen?
0.answer: Fort Lauderdale, Broward, and Miami at the starting range. Trips outside the immediate metro add a travel fee — included in the quote, never surprise-billed.

1.question: How many posts can I get out of one Content Day?
1.answer: A typical session yields one hero edit and three to five vertical clips. Heavier batches (eight to ten clips) scope into the Local Business Monthly retainer.

2.question: Do you bring lighting and audio?
2.answer: Yes when the shoot needs it. The kit list lives on the About page and adapts to the project — a quick chef portrait does not need the same setup as a founder interview.

3.question: Can the same content day also produce stills?
3.answer: Yes, when the shot list leaves room for stills. Supporting photos are part of the deliverable, but the day is planned video-first.

local-business-monthly.name: Local Business Monthly
local-business-monthly.tagline: A monthly content rhythm for local brands that need eight to twelve clips a month.
local-business-monthly.blurb: One monthly shoot or footage drop becomes eight to twelve platform-ready clips with captions, a shared delivery folder, and a simple posting plan.
local-business-monthly.audience: Restaurants, gyms, salons, med spas, creators, and local brands committed to repeat short-form posting on Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts.

deliverables.0: One monthly shoot or footage drop (your choice)
deliverables.1: Eight to twelve vertical Reels, Shorts, or TikTok edits
deliverables.2: Captions, music direction, and platform-ready exports
deliverables.3: Shared delivery folder organised by platform and post date
deliverables.4: Simple posting plan and reuse map — what to publish, when, and where

caveats.0: Minimum three-month commitment recommended for ranking and posting consistency — month-to-month is available but priced higher
caveats.1: Travel beyond South Florida and additional shoot days scope up the retainer for that month
caveats.2: Paid media buying, comment moderation, and account management live outside this package

0.question: How does the monthly content session work?
0.answer: Either Esteban shoots one focused session each month, or you send a footage drop from phone, camera, or drone. Either path produces the same delivery rhythm.

1.question: Can the retainer pause for slow months?
1.answer: Yes — pause one month with two weeks' notice and the retainer picks back up the following month. Long pauses re-quote against the latest scope.

2.question: Who posts the clips to Instagram or TikTok?
2.answer: You or your team posts. Esteban delivers the clips, captions, and a simple post plan — handing publishing access keeps the brand voice yours.

3.question: Can this include drone or aerial footage?
3.answer: Yes when the location, weather, airspace, and legal requirements allow. Aerial selects integrate into the monthly batch instead of shipping as standalone flyovers.
